theorem.justification: This theorem records the affirmative all-\(x_0\) answer to the fixed-\(n\) component-mixture question as a direct consequence of the established component certificate.
theorem.gap: One-observation mixture cancellation alone does not control a shared-prior product likelihood; the invoked component theorem supplies the exact singleton cancellation, component affinity estimate, and full graph sum in the stipulated experiment.
theorem.consumer: The certificate is the fixed-product lower-bound input used by the sharp exact-uniform pointwise CATE minimax theorem.

prose_updates.related_work: KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024MinimaxCATE is the closest comparator: its lower theorem covers a broader bounded-density class and its upper theorem requires additional design and nuisance-estimation conditions, whereas the present result closes the fixed-\(n\) converse and matching upper bound on the strict exact-uniform bounded-overlap Bernoulli/interiority subclass. The lower converse therefore transfers upward by subclass inclusion to any broader model that contains this subclass and uses the same point target; the exact-uniform upper proof does not transfer in that direction and is not claimed there. RobinsTchetgenLiVanderVaart2009SemiparametricMinimax supplies the product-mixture perspective, but the shared smooth frames here require random overlap-component factorization rather than a deterministic coordinate-local partition. ShenGaoWittenHan2020Variance is a random-design nonlinear-functional analogue for repeated local occupancy. Kennedy2023DRCATE and NieWager2021RLearner provide oracle-facing upper comparisons, while RobinsLiTchetgenVanderVaart2008HOIF motivates the finite projection correction. LiuMukherjeeRobinsTchetgen2021Adaptive studies adaptive nonlinear-functional estimation, whereas the present estimator uses known smoothness. LeeOkuiWhang2017CATEBands studies uniform CATE confidence bands, whereas this note proves pointwise mean-risk only. AtheyWager2021PolicyLearning studies policy-value and regret learning rather than pointwise CATE minimax precision. ChernozhukovWuthrichZhu2021Conformal studies conformal counterfactual and synthetic-control inference rather than this estimand or guarantee. WagerAthey2018CausalForests is an application-facing consumer: this is a precision benchmark for \(\texttt{causal\_forest}\) and R-learner workflows, not a claim that existing forests attain the bound.
